## Persistent sessions

- Add a per-connection "When earlier shells are running" setting: resume or ask (default), always start new, or end detached shells and start new.
- The connect picker lists earlier shells by folder and program, detached first, and can end the detached ones and start fresh.
- The session manager gains End All Detached and marks shells that are open in a tab. Close Others and Close All can end the closing tabs' sessions.
- Shells owned by a tab or attached from another client are never ended automatically, and an attached shell is never resumed without asking.

## Session tree

- Show a session's host after its name when the row is selected or hovered, on the same line so rows no longer shift under a double-click.
- Replace the Nokia, Juniper and Cisco wordmark icons, which blurred at tree size, with each vendor's compact favicon mark. Arista and VyOS get their own icons instead of the generic network and router glyphs.
- Use clearer stacked-box icons for Expand All and Collapse All.

## Tabs and terminals

- Tab switches and closes no longer flash WebView2's gray fill, and switching between terminals that have already rendered is instant.
- Improve tab selection, drag scrolling and command palette search, keep tab drag previews within the tab bar, and restore targeted tab animations.
- Clicking a tab header hands focus straight back to the terminal.

## Fixes and polish

- Fix a crash when moving the window between monitors with different DPI.
- Polish the Welcome page layout and themes, settings, and terminal navigation.
- Bring the README and roadmap in line with the shipped features.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/bpbp-boop/resesh/compare/v0.12.1...v0.13.0)
